Trayago Android App

AI-powered train journey planning, live GPS tracking, PNR prediction, and alternative route discovery — built for Indian Railways travelers on Android.

Download on Google PlayUse Web Version

What Is the Trayago Android App?

The Trayago Android app brings the full power of AI-driven train journey intelligence to your mobile device. Whether you're planning a complex multi-city journey, tracking a live train, or checking PNR confirmation chances, the app is designed to make Indian rail travel smarter and more predictable.

Trayago is an independent platform and is not affiliated with IRCTC or Indian Railways. Ticket booking is completed through official railway booking platforms.

Core Features

AI Route Discovery

Discover hidden alternative routes and multi-leg journey combinations when direct trains are waitlisted or unavailable.

AI Waitlist Rescue

Find practical split journey options when your preferred direct train is fully booked or has a heavy waitlist.

Live Train GPS Tracking

Track your train&apos;s current position in real time with GPS-powered location updates and estimated arrival times.

PNR Status & Prediction

Check PNR status and get AI-powered confirmation probability estimates based on historical data patterns.

Train Schedule & Timetable

Access complete train schedules with station-by-station timing, arrival/departure information across India.

Pan-India Coverage

Full Indian Railways network coverage — from major intercity corridors to regional routes across all states.

How the Android App Works

1

Download & Open

Install the Trayago Android app and launch it from your device.

2

Enter Journey Details

Type your departure station, destination, and travel date.

3

Review AI-Powered Routes

The app analyzes direct trains and multi-leg alternatives, showing you the best availability options.

4

Track Live Trains

Use the live status feature to monitor your train&apos;s current position and delay status via GPS.

5

Check PNR Confirmation

Enter your PNR to see current status and estimated confirmation probability.

6

Book Through Official Channels

When you&apos;ve decided on a route, proceed to IRCTC or official booking platforms to complete your ticket purchase.

Why Use the Trayago Android App?

  • Native Android performance — Fast, responsive interface optimized for mobile devices.
  • Offline capability — Access saved searches and PNR history even without connectivity.
  • Push notifications — Get alerts for PNR status changes, train delays, and journey updates.
  • Free to use — Core train search, live status, and PNR checking are completely free.
  • No IRCTC login required — Search trains, check status, and explore routes without sharing credentials.

Platform Availability

The Trayago Android app is currently available for devices running Android 8.0 (Oreo) and above. An iOS version is planned for future release. You can also access all Trayago features through the web app at trayago.in on any device with a modern browser.

Ready to Travel Smarter?

Whether you're using the Android app or the web platform, Trayago helps you find better routes, track trains live, and understand your PNR confirmation chances before you travel.
